{{Quote|Star Tours Flight 55 is now ready for boarding at gate number 3. At this time, we would like to board those passengers with droids or anyone requiring special assistance. Thank you.|Star Tours announcer|<ref name="Star Tours (real-world)">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>}}
'''Star Tours Flight 55''' was the designation of a flight offered to passengers by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency around the time of the [[Battle of Death Star III]].
